text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An important trial race leading up to the 
prestigious Tenno Sho (Spring). Despite 
what's at stake, Tamamo Cross can't seem 
to settle down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but wonder about Oguri 
Cap, who had finally conquered graded 
stakes races in the Classic Year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer's words, "Let's stay focused," 
finally brought Tamamo Cross back to her 
senses, and she headed off to the race.
